# MSZIP oracle controls

These 44 inert cabinets are generated by the retained
[`generate_oracle.py`](../../../../../docs/edr/native-engine/audits/2026-11-07-v244-mszip/generate_oracle.py)
using Python's independent zlib compressor, deterministic input recipes and
random seed 244. They contain harmless text, byte patterns, weighted random
letters or runs, at 59, 4,096 and 32,768 bytes. Levels 1/6/9 and eight
truncation/header mutations exercise stored, fixed and dynamic blocks.

`manifest.json` records the CAB hash and the actual extracted child SHA-256
reported by SHA-pinned ClamAV 1.5.4, not an output assumed from the source
plaintext or derived by the Go decoder. Some inputs produce repaired bytes.
The [audit](../../../../../docs/edr/native-engine/audits/2026-11-07-v244-mszip/REPORT.md)
retains native debug logs, generator/runtime provenance and tool hashes.
Nothing in these controls is executed. This is format/repair evidence,
not an independently labelled malware efficacy corpus.
